title: Registro de diminutivos
reviewer: Codex R33 local semantic source review

semanticReview.method: Inspección directa de fuente académica/institucional y pasaje localizado; artículo acotado; APA 7, Evidence y assessEntry posterior ejecutados.
findings: Trubnikova analyzes Russian diminutive forms through politeness and speech-act theory and reports that perceived appropriateness varies with social distance and power; the entry is narrowed to this situational variability, not a universal register rule.
Localizador: Abstract and introduction, publisher full text lines 170–185; the study relates pragmatic appropriateness to communicative situations, politeness, social distance and power.

APA 7: Trubnikova, V. Y. (2021). Pragmatic (In)appropriateness of Diminutives in Russian Language. RUDN Journal of Language Studies, Semiotics and Semantics, 12(4), 1160–1174. https://doi.org/10.22363/2313-2299-2021-12-4-1160-1174
limitations: Se eliminaron afirmaciones de frecuencia, registro o significado fuera del alcance verificado.
Se conservaron los enlaces de entradas relacionadas originales.
